articles.summary: CARMEL, Ind. (Nov. 12, 2026)—Leading financial services provider Merchants Capital today announced $15.5 million in financing for the construction of Ryans Way, a 60-unit low-income housing tax credit (LIHTC) development in Charlotte, N.C. developed by Scantland, Inc. Merchants Capital secured $11.1 million in federal LIHTC as the syndicator for Ryans Way. It also arranged $4.4 million in Freddie Mac Forward permanent financing to facilitate construction loan refinancing. “Merchants Capital’s ability to align debt and equity sources across the capital stack enables us to provide efficient, tailored financing solutions for our partners,” said Marcin Dzido, Vice President of Acquisitions at Merchants Capital. “We are pleased to have helped facilitate the financing of Ryans Way, a development that will bring 60 much-needed affordable homes to the Charlotte community.” “At a time when rising interest rates and escalating development costs continue to challenge the delivery of affordable housing, we work closely with our clients to identify the best financing options for them to help us execute and deliver the financing they need for a viable project,” said Jeff Spahn, Senior Vice President of Originations at Merchants Capital. “We value our partnership with Scantland, Inc. and are proud to support a development that will …
articles.title: Merchants Capital Secures $15M+ for Affordable Housing Development in Charlotte, N.C.

articles.summary: Merchants Capital to Acquire Remaining Interest in VIUM Capital, Expanding Its Seniors Housing and Healthcare Lending Platform Transaction builds on a long-standing partnership and diversifies Merchants’ income CARMEL, Ind. (November 19, 2026)—Merchants Bancorp (“Merchants”) today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Merchants Capital Corp. (“MCC”) has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the remaining ownership interest in VIUM Capital, LLC (“VIUM”) that MCC does not currently own. VIUM is a leading healthcare and seniors housing lending platform. After closing, VIUM will become a division of MCC. Under the agreement, total net consideration is expected to be approximately $135 million over five years, inclusive of payments at closing, deferred payments and performance-based consideration, and includes a mortgage servicing rights asset associated with approximately $2.5 billion in unpaid principal balance of serviced loans. The transaction is expected to close on January 1, 2027, subject to customary closing conditions. Merchants expects the acquisition to diversify its income and to contribute additional annual net income in excess of $15 million. Full ownership builds on Merchants’ existing balance sheet healthcare finance business and expands MCC’s presence in seniors housing and healthcare. articles.title: Merchants Capital to Acquire Remaining Interest in VIUM Capital, Expanding Its Seniors Housing and Healthcare Lending Platform

articles.summary: NEW YORK (Nov. 5, 2026)—Leading financial services provider Merchants Capital today announced $185 million in financing for the acquisition and rehabilitation of Nostrand Houses, a 1,148-unit multifamily property located in the Sheepshead Bay neighborhood of Brooklyn, N.Y. It is the first financial closing for the New York City Public Housing Preservation Trust (the Trust), developer of Nostrand Houses. Merchants Capital structured a $185 million taxable loan provided by Merchants Bank for Nostrand Houses; $50 million of the total loan was provided by the AFL-CIO Housing Investment Trust (HIT), who acted as co-lender for the transaction. “With Merchants’ highly collaborative approach, our team was able to provide critical financing for Nostrand Houses in partnership with AFL-CIO HIT,” said Joshua Canan, Senior Vice President of Originations at Merchants Capital. “Merchants Capital is honored to serve as financing partner in support of the Trust, and we look forward to future partnerships that advance affordable housing and strengthen communities.” “We feel a deep debt of gratitude to be counted among dedicated partners who are transforming the state of housing in New York City,” said Mathew Wambua, Vicechair and Executive Vice President of Agency Lending at Merchants Capital. “This closing marks a new model of …
articles.title: Merchants Capital Secures $185M for 1,148-Unit Multifamily Development Rehabilitation in Brooklyn, N.Y.
